# Torque Studio · Senior design on subscription

> A senior designer and a head of operations on your team, not on your payroll. Design direction for product companies and consumer brands that need a lot of design, fast. Ads, campaigns, websites, decks and landing pages: thought through by hand, produced with AI in the engine room, shipped in days, not months. On subscription. One flat monthly fee.

Torque Studio is a design studio on subscription, run by Pavlo Lobodiuk (Founder · Senior Designer) and Anastasiia Odiehova (Head of Operations), for product companies and consumer brands: a senior designer who owns the thinking, a head of operations who runs the queue and the deadlines, and an AI production engine that does the volume inside rules set by hand. Every piece is reviewed before it ships. Requests come back within 3 working days. Three plans, by how many requests are in progress at the same time: Ignition (one, €2,000 a month), Cruise (two, €3,500 a month), Full Throttle (three, €4,500 a month); 10% off when paid quarterly. The fee stays flat until the plan changes. Full company websites are a separate project, from €3,000 to €10,000 depending on pages, functionality and content.

## Services ("Everything your marketing runs on")

- **Campaign landing pages**: Single pages for ads, launches and events. Designed, built, launched and hosted, no developer needed.
- **Ad creatives**: Several versions to test, not one pretty version.
- **Pitch decks**: Complex product stories made simple for investors and buyers.
- **Social media**: Posts, carousels, covers. Consistent every week.
- **AI visuals & video**: Product shots, campaign imagery, animated banners and short AI video.

## Work

Client work is under NDA. These six are concept brands that show how the studio thinks: one idea carried through every campaign, ad and page.
- Betting & iGaming: Fewer slots, each one finished.
- Running Shoes: Show the engineering, skip the hype.
- Architecture Firm: Feel the buildings before you meet the architect.
- Urban Sunglasses: Six frames. 640 pairs. Then gone.
- IT Company: A product you can’t see, made trustworthy.
- Beverage: A soda that explains itself.
